description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NotConnectedException' used for indicating a 'not connected' error scenario within the application's ECU (Engine Control Unit) communication module.

classes.name: NotConnectedException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that an ECU connection has not been established or has been lost.

methods.name: NotConnectedException()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an instance without a message or cause.

methods.name: NotConnectedException(String string)
methods.description: Constructs an instance with a specific error message.

methods.name: NotConnectedException(String string, Throwable throwable)
methods.description: Constructs an instance with a message and a cause throwable.

methods.name: NotConnectedException(Throwable throwable)
methods.description: Constructs an instance with a cause throwable.
